    • Constructor Detail

      • Function

        public Function(Token t,
                Body b,
                Scope filescope,
                boolean pvt)
        Construct a function definition.
        Parameters:
        t - is the function identifier token which provides both the function identifier and the source file location of the definition
        b - is the enclosing module, procedure or function or is null for a file module
        filescope - is the file scope for the module
        pvt - is true if this procedure is declared as 'private'

        public void setReturn(Val r)

      • setUsedFunc

        public Val setUsedFunc()
        Set a 'used' value for the function call, i.e. function used() has been called. On first use of this function instance generate a new Val usedval. On further calls to used() return the established Val usedval.
        Returns:
        a target value which is true when the function is executed in the FPGA
